info.name: Weather Underground PWS Forecast Historical API
Get hourly observations for the past 7 days

params.name: stationId
params.description: The PWS station identifier (e.g., KCASARAT1). Station IDs are assigned upon registration with Weather Underground's PWS network.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Only JSON is currently supported.

params.name: units
params.description: Unit system for measurement values. e = Imperial (English), m = Metric, s = SI (metric with Pa pressure), h = Hybrid (UK)

params.name: numericPrecision
params.description: When set to "decimal", numeric values are returned with decimal precision instead of rounded integers.

items.docs: Returns hourly observation records for a specified Personal Weather Station over the past 7 days. Each record represents aggregated observations for a one-hour period.

info.name: Get daily summary observations for the past 7 days

params.name: stationId
params.description: The PWS station identifier (e.g., KCASARAT1). Station IDs are assigned upon registration with Weather Underground's PWS network.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Only JSON is currently supported.

params.name: units
params.description: Unit system for measurement values. e = Imperial (English), m = Metric, s = SI (metric with Pa pressure), h = Hybrid (UK)

params.name: numericPrecision
params.description: When set to "decimal", numeric values are returned with decimal precision instead of rounded integers.

items.docs: Returns daily summary observation records for a specified Personal Weather Station over the past 7 days. Each record aggregates all observations from a single calendar day into min/max/average values.

info.name: Get all historical observations for a specific date

params.name: stationId
params.description: The PWS station identifier (e.g., KCASARAT1). Station IDs are assigned upon registration with Weather Underground's PWS network.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Only JSON is currently supported.

params.name: units
params.description: Unit system for measurement values. e = Imperial (English), m = Metric, s = SI (metric with Pa pressure), h = Hybrid (UK)

params.name: numericPrecision
params.description: When set to "decimal", numeric values are returned with decimal precision instead of rounded integers.

params.name: date
params.description: Date for historical observations in YYYYMMDD format

items.docs: Returns all raw observation records for a specified Personal Weather Station on a given historical date. Provides the full granularity of data uploaded by the station for that date.

info.name: Get daily historical observations for a date range

params.name: stationId
params.description: The PWS station identifier (e.g., KCASARAT1). Station IDs are assigned upon registration with Weather Underground's PWS network.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Only JSON is currently supported.

params.name: units
params.description: Unit system for measurement values. e = Imperial (English), m = Metric, s = SI (metric with Pa pressure), h = Hybrid (UK)

params.name: numericPrecision
params.description: When set to "decimal", numeric values are returned with decimal precision instead of rounded integers.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date of the range in YYYYMMDD format

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date of the range in YYYYMMDD format

items.docs: Returns daily summary historical records for a specified Personal Weather Station within a date range. Supports up to approximately one month of daily summaries per request.
